authority: Exact 42-image identity set retained in seal6_smg_texture_keys_v4.json, corrected by cross-repository lookup with the retail T6 filename hash plus exact streamed dataHash. This file is a build-time resolution contract, not a substitute for the generated materialization report.
sourceIdentityManifestPolicy: The historical repository/nameHash labels in v4 are non-authoritative. tools/t6_ipak_iwi_materialize_v3.py derives the retail IPAK filename hash from the exact image name and searches the exact (filenameHash,dataHash) pair across every supplied repository.

materializer.identityRule: exact image name -> retail T6 filename hash; pair with exact streamed dataHash; require exactly one match across base.ipak + mp.ipak

passCondition: A generated t6-ipak-iwi-materialization-v3 manifest reports requested=42, materialized=42, unresolved=0, repositories.base.ipak=40, repositories.mp.ipak=2, with both supplied IPAKs matching the hashes above.
proofBoundary: This contract pins the already identified cross-IPAK repository split and exact two mp.ipak exceptions. It does not claim that a fresh payload materialization has occurred merely because this file exists; only the generated v3 materialization manifest can close that execution step.
